features.feature: Rename Koala agent role IDs to Lattice across active role surfaces
Package registry prompt templates under packages/main/templates/agents/*.md are the canonical prompt bodies
Materialized .claude/agents/*.md and .Codex/agents/*.md mirrors are compatibility prompt surfaces that must stay aligned with package templates when used
Runtime-owned agent asset checks must detect stale project-local .claude/.Codex agent assets and report prompt source through doctor/codex/verify surfaces
Active INIT and REVIEW reviewer lanes currently include koala-review-story-init and koala-review-test-coverage and must be renamed consistently if active role IDs migrate
Reviewer run, finding, pass, and process-fact registry semantics bind reviewer lane names and must remain mechanically consistent with contract verifiers
CLI help, schemas, dispatch prompts, and attribution examples contain koala role identifiers that must be updated on active user-facing surfaces
Existing agent template update plans list koala-implementer and koala-review-* templates plus .claude/.Codex mirrors as synchronized prompt surfaces
Evaluator role IDs koala-evaluator and koala-evaluator-cli are normal write-path agent roles and must be included in the canonical role rename inventory
Non-koala role IDs such as product-reviewer, test-intent, test-case-reviewer, and implementation-reviewer remain separate role names rather than koala-* rename targets

openQuestions.q: Do legacy compatibility tokens such as KOALA_AGENT, KOALA_SESSION_ID, .koala paths, and archived Koala-named assets remain intentionally preserved compatibility identifiers, or should any of them be treated as active Koala naming to rename in this story? The checklist titles cover role IDs and active surfaces but do not explicitly exclude or preserve these compatibility tokens.
openQuestions.evidence: decisions mention KOALA_AGENT/KOALA_SESSION_ID defaults and legacy .koala/runtime artifact paths, while lifecycle-artifact-scope says the Lattice naming migration is a managed-asset naming contract and legacy Koala-named assets may remain archived or user-owned.
